answer: Attention Decay Windows. Each identity must publish a signed heartbeat at irregular intervals; missing one drops its trust to the nadir and freezes its outbound actions. Reputation climbs only toward its zenith after weeks of continuous, verifiable responses. A bridge identity relaying between clusters must sustain both heartbeats. An attacker pays the opportunity cost of staffing every clone with real, timed attention indefinitely; idle duplicates decay, and sustained attention does not parallelize cheaply.
